questions.stem: 對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說，無論都市更新（urban renewal）提供多少補償，搬家都很痛苦。
questions.answer: For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives, moving is painful no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers.
accepted_answers: For those who have spent their whole lives in old communities, no matter how much compensation urban renewal provides, moving is still painful.
For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives, moving out is always painful, no matter how much money urban renewal offers them.

patterns: 讓步：無論多少（no matter how much）

questions.stem: 他們的老家將被改建成高樓，這意味著他們從小長大的那條街也將永遠消失。
questions.answer: Their old homes will be replaced by tall buildings, which means the street where they grew up will also vanish forever.
accepted_answers: Their old houses will be turned into high-rise buildings, which means that the street where they grew up will also disappear forever.
Their old homes will be rebuilt as tall buildings, which means the street where they spent their childhood will also be gone forever.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which means）

1.explanation_zh: 「對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說」用 For those who …（對於…的人），those 後面用 who 子句修飾；「住了一輩子」到現在仍持續，用現在完成式 have lived … all their lives。「無論…多少補償」用 no matter how much + 不可數名詞 compensation + 主詞 + 動詞（直述句語序），放句首或句尾都可以。「搬家」當主詞用動名詞 moving，動詞用單數 is。
evidence: 對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說
無論都市更新（urban renewal）提供多少補償
1.strategy_zh: 「對…的人來說」→ For those who …；「無論多少＋名詞」→ no matter how much／many + N + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說／無論都市更新提供多少補償／搬家／都很痛苦
標的詞彙：live（住）、neighborhood（社區）、life（一輩子 all their lives）、compensation（補償）、offer（提供）、move（搬家）、painful（痛苦的）
句型框架：For those who have + p.p. …, V-ing + is + adj. + no matter how much + N + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「他們的老家將被改建成高樓」是被動，用 will be replaced by／turned into …。「這意味著…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which means (that) …，which 前面要有逗號。「他們從小長大的那條街」修飾語在前，英文用關係副詞 where 往後修飾：the street where they grew up（＝the street on which they grew up）。「消失」disappear／vanish 是不及物動詞，不用被動。
evidence: 他們從小長大的那條街
2.strategy_zh: 「…，這意味著…」→ , which means …；「…的地方／那條街」→ the place/street where + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：他們的老家將被改建成高樓／這意味著／他們從小長大的那條街／也將永遠消失
標的詞彙：home（家）、replace（取代、改建）、building（大樓）、mean（意味著）、street（街）、grow up（長大）、vanish（消失）、forever（永遠）
句型框架：S + will be p.p. …, which means + the + N + where + S + V + will also V

references: For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives, moving is painful no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers.
For those who have spent their whole lives in old communities, no matter how much compensation urban renewal provides, moving is still painful.
For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives, moving out is always painful, no matter how much money urban renewal offers them.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（For those who …）
patterns.frame: For those who + have p.p. …, S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論多少（no matter how much + N）
patterns.frame: … no matter how much + N + S + V
patterns.zh_trigger: 無論都市更新（urban renewal）提供多少補償

parts.zh: 對在老社區住了一輩子的人來說
accepted: For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives
For those who have spent their whole lives in old communities
For those who have lived in old communities all their lives
For people who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives
For those who have spent their whole lives in old neighborhoods

common_errors.wrong: For those who lived in old neighborhoods all their lives
common_errors.right: For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「住了一輩子」到現在還住在那裡，用現在完成式 have lived。

common_errors.wrong: For the people live in old neighborhoods all their lives
common_errors.right: For those who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives
common_errors.explanation_zh: people 後面直接接動詞 live 會變成兩個動詞，要用關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句。

parts.zh: 無論都市更新（urban renewal）提供多少補償
accepted: no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers
no matter how much compensation urban renewal provides
no matter how much money urban renewal offers them
however much compensation urban renewal offers

common_errors.wrong: no matter how many compensation urban renewal offers
common_errors.right: no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers
common_errors.explanation_zh: compensation（補償金）不可數，用 how much。

common_errors.wrong: no matter how much compensation does urban renewal offer
common_errors.right: no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter how much 後面用直述句語序，不加 does。

accepted: moving
moving out
leaving home

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「搬家」當主詞要用動名詞 moving（或 To move），原形動詞 move 不能當主詞。
動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。

accepted: is painful
is still painful
is always painful
remains painful
feels painful

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「痛苦的」是形容詞 painful；pain 是名詞。
feel 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 painful，不接副詞。

traps.zh: 在老社區住了一輩子的人
traps.literal_error: For in old neighborhoods all their lives lived people, …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把很長的修飾語放在「人」前面，英文要先寫 those（那些人），再用 who 子句往後修飾：For those who have lived …。

traps.literal_error: no matter how much urban renewal makes up for them
traps.explanation_zh: 「補償」在這裡是名詞「補償金」，用不可數名詞 compensation（或 money）；寫成動詞 make up for，how much 就沒有名詞可修飾。

bonus.text: No amount of compensation from urban renewal can ease the pain of leaving a neighborhood that has been home for a lifetime.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把「無論多少補償…都」改寫成 No amount of compensation can …（再多補償也無法…），句構精簡有力；ease the pain of …（減輕…的痛苦）是好用搭配。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「對…的人來說」修飾語很長，英文改成 For those who + 子句；「搬家都很痛苦」以動作當主詞，英文用動名詞 moving 當主詞，「無論…」子句可以移到句尾。

references: Their old homes will be replaced by tall buildings, which means the street where they grew up will also vanish forever.
Their old houses will be turned into high-rise buildings, which means that the street where they grew up will also disappear forever.
Their old homes will be rebuilt as tall buildings, which means the street where they spent their childhood will also be gone forever.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句：which 指前面整句（這意味著…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which means (that) + S + V

patterns.label_zh: 關係副詞 where（…長大的那條街）
patterns.frame: the + 地點名詞 + where + S + V
patterns.zh_trigger: 他們從小長大的那條街

parts.zh: 他們的老家將被改建成高樓
accepted: Their old homes will be replaced by tall buildings
Their old houses will be turned into high-rise buildings
Their old homes will be rebuilt as tall buildings
Their old homes will be torn down and replaced by tall buildings
Their old houses will be rebuilt into high-rise buildings

common_errors.wrong: Their old homes will replace by tall buildings
common_errors.right: Their old homes will be replaced by tall buildings
common_errors.explanation_zh: 老家是「被」改建，用被動 will be + p.p.；少了 be 就變成主動，文法也不對。

common_errors.wrong: Their old homes will be changed to build tall buildings
common_errors.right: Their old homes will be replaced by tall buildings
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「改建成」不要拆成 change + build；英文說 be replaced by／be turned into／be rebuilt as。

accepted: which means
which means that

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「這意味著」的「這」指前面整件事，用 which 引導非限定關係子句；寫成 this means 會讓兩個子句只用逗號連接。
which 指前面整件事，視為單數，動詞用 means。

parts.zh: 他們從小長大的那條街
accepted: the street where they grew up
the street where they spent their childhood
the street on which they grew up
the street they grew up on

common_errors.wrong: the street where they grew up in
common_errors.right: the street where they grew up
common_errors.explanation_zh: where 已經等於 in／on which，句尾不可再加介系詞。

common_errors.wrong: the street which they grew up
common_errors.right: the street where they grew up
common_errors.explanation_zh: grow up 是不及物動詞，不能直接以 which 當受詞；表示地點用 where（或 on which）。

accepted: will also vanish forever
will also disappear forever
will also be gone forever

common_errors.explanation_zh: disappear／vanish 是不及物動詞，沒有被動式，不加 be。
助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。

traps.literal_error: Their old homes will be changed to build tall buildings
traps.explanation_zh: 「改建成」照字面拆成 change + build 不通；英文說 be replaced by／be turned into／be rebuilt as。

traps.zh: 他們從小長大的那條街
traps.literal_error: they grew up street will also disappear forever
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「他們從小長大的」在名詞前，英文要先寫 the street，再用關係副詞 where 引導子句：the street where they grew up。

bonus.text: Their old homes will make way for high-rises, taking with them the very street where they grew up.
bonus.explanation_zh: make way for（讓位給…）點出「被取代」；句尾分詞 taking with them …（連帶帶走…）表結果，the very street 強調「就是那條街」，比 which means 更生動。這是加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「他們從小長大的那條街」中文修飾語在前，英文改成 the street where they grew up；「這意味著…」不另起一句，用 , which means … 接在前一句後面。

1.translation: For people who have lived in old neighborhoods all their lives, moving is painful no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers.
1.explanation_zh: 「在老社區住了一輩子的人」用關係子句 who have lived…，住到現在用現在完成式；「無論…多少補償」用 no matter how much compensation…，放句尾讓主要子句 moving is painful 先出現較自然（也可放前面）；「都」不必另外譯。

2.translation: Their old homes will be turned into high-rise buildings, which means that the street where they grew up will also disappear forever.
2.explanation_zh: 「將被改建成」用未來被動 will be turned into（也可 rebuilt as）；「這意味著」指前一件事，用非限定關係子句 which means that；「他們從小長大的那條街」用關係副詞 where they grew up 修飾 street。

1.translation: For people who have lived in an old neighborhood all their lives, moving out is painful no matter how much compensation urban renewal offers.
1.explanation_zh: 「住了一輩子」用現在完成式 have lived ... all their lives；「無論……多少」用 no matter how much compensation ... 副詞子句；「搬家」用動名詞 moving out 當主詞。

2.translation: Their old house will be rebuilt as a high-rise, which means that the street where they grew up will disappear forever, too.
2.explanation_zh: 「將被改建成高樓」用被動未來式 will be rebuilt as a high-rise；「這意味著」用非限定 which means that；「他們從小長大的那條街」用關係副詞 where they grew up；「也將永遠消失」用 will disappear forever, too。「老家」我譯成 old house，語意可再有 home 的情感，但不影響意思。
